file_nodes.name: package.json
file_nodes.summary: Nuxt application package manifest defining project name, scripts (build, dev, generate, preview, postinstall), and dependencies including Nuxt 4, Vue 3, Naive UI, Tailwind CSS v4, and anime.js.

file_nodes.name: package-lock.json
file_nodes.summary: npm lockfile pinning exact dependency versions and their dependency trees for reproducible installs.

file_nodes.name: pnpm-lock.yaml
file_nodes.summary: pnpm lockfile pinning exact dependency versions and integrity hashes for reproducible installs.

file_nodes.name: pnpm-workspace.yaml
file_nodes.summary: pnpm workspace configuration with esbuild build policy setting.

file_nodes.name: tsconfig.json
file_nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration referencing Nuxt-generated tsconfig files for app, server, shared, and node contexts.

file_nodes.name: API Architecture
file_nodes.summary: Defines RESTful API conventions for the Persuratan platform including JSON response formats (success/error), HTTP method usage (GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE), Zod-based input validation, session-based authentication, role-based authorization (RBAC), pagination with query parameters, and filtering.

file_nodes.name: Architecture Rules
file_nodes.summary: Mandatory architectural rules for all AI agents: strict layer separation (Page→Component→Composable→API Route→Service→Repository→Database), reuse-before-create principle, no modification of unrelated code, consistent naming conventions, TypeScript strictness with no any types, structured error handling, metadata-driven design for user-defined structures, and framework-independent domain engines.

file_nodes.name: Backend Architecture
file_nodes.summary: Describes the Nitro-based backend architecture with detailed server structure under app/server/: API route handlers (collections, components, templates, workflows, documents, files), service layer for business logic, repository layer for data access via Drizzle ORM, and five domain engines (Expression, Binding, Component, Template, Document). Includes complete HTTP request flow from route to database.

file_nodes.name: Database Architecture
file_nodes.summary: Documents the SQLite + Drizzle ORM database architecture using a hybrid approach: fixed metadata tables for Global Tables, Components, Templates, Administrations, and Documents definitions, combined with JSONB-based dynamic data storage for user-defined records. Covers naming conventions (nanoid/UUID IDs, timestamps, soft delete, JSONB columns), migration strategy via Drizzle Kit, and schema file locations.

file_nodes.name: Frontend Architecture
file_nodes.summary: Details the Nuxt 4 + Vue 3 Composition API frontend with TypeScript, Nuxt UI component library, and Tailwind CSS styling. Describes client app structure (pages, components, composables, layouts, middleware, plugins), component architecture hierarchy (Primitive→Pattern→Feature→Page), state management via Pinia and composables, and Tiptap editor integration with custom ProseMirror nodes (DynamicText, Component, Loop, Condition, PageBreak).

file_nodes.name: Architecture Overview
file_nodes.summary: High-level architecture overview describing the unified full-stack Nuxt 4 + Nitro application with three major layers (Client/Server/Data). Defines six major modules (Collections, Components, Templates, Workflows, Documents, Expression Engine) and their responsibilities. Documents the complete data flow from user action through Nuxt Page/Component → Composable → Nitro API Route → Service → Domain Engine → Repository → Drizzle ORM → SQLite.

file_nodes.name: Security
file_nodes.summary: Covers security implementation: session-based authentication using Nitro session handling with HTTP-only cookies (no JWT), role-based authorization (Administrator/Staff/Manager) with permission checks at service layer, Zod-based server-side validation as authoritative, data protection via Drizzle parameterized queries (SQL injection prevention) and Vue template escaping (XSS prevention), and environment variable-based secrets management.

file_nodes.name: System Context
file_nodes.summary: Defines the system boundary with three actors (User/Browser, Persuratan Nuxt App, SQLite Database) and one external dependency (File System for storage). In-scope features: dynamic data structures, reusable document components, template composition, administration workflows, document rendering (HTML+PDF), file management, authentication/authorization. Out-of-scope: external databases, third-party document services, external auth providers, mobile native apps, real-time collaboration.

file_nodes.name: Technology Stack
file_nodes.summary: Comprehensive technology inventory across Core (Nuxt 4, Nitro, Vue 3, TypeScript 5, Node.js 20+), Frontend (Nuxt UI, Tailwind CSS v4, Tiptap, Pinia, VueUse, TanStack Table, vee-validate, Zod, date-fns, Lucide), Backend (Drizzle ORM, SQLite, Zod, Sharp, Pino), Document Engine (Tiptap/ProseMirror, Playwright), and Testing (Vitest, Playwright E2E). Notes that naive-ui is currently installed but Nuxt UI is the design target. Package manager is pnpm.

file_nodes.summary: Accessibility guidelines covering keyboard navigation, focus management, labels, semantic structure, contrast ratios, screen reader support, and validation feedback for the Persuratan application.

file_nodes.name: component-guidelines.md
file_nodes.summary: Component development guidelines defining reuse-first philosophy, naming conventions (Primitive/Pattern/Feature/Page), single-responsibility principle, composition over inheritance, variant patterns via props, required interactive states, and file organization structure.

file_nodes.name: design-system.md
file_nodes.summary: Core design system defining the 'Professional Workspace' design language with foundations: color tokens (primary, semantic), surface system, typography scale, 4px spacing grid, border radius tokens, elevation levels, component library layering (Nuxt UI → Tokens → App → Feature), and Lucide icon system.

file_nodes.name: interaction-patterns.md
file_nodes.summary: Eight UI interaction patterns: workspace navigation (sidebar/resource/canvas), builder canvas (left/center/right panels), command palette (Cmd+K), form submission with validation, destructive action confirmation, drag and drop, split view (editor + preview), and step wizard with progress indicator.

file_nodes.name: responsive.md
file_nodes.summary: Responsive design strategy defining breakpoints (sm/md/lg/xl/2xl), desktop workspace layout (sidebar+canvas+properties), tablet collapsible sidebar, mobile single-column with bottom navigation, plus responsive tables, forms, and navigation behavior across breakpoints.

file_nodes.name: ui-principles.md
file_nodes.summary: UI design principles covering visual hierarchy (title→context→action→content→secondary), consistency via design tokens, density for power users, clarity with one primary action per section, information architecture with tabs/breadcrumbs/sidebar, and the workspace concept (sidebar+canvas+properties).

file_nodes.name: ux-principles.md
file_nodes.summary: UX principles covering discoverability (visible actions, command palette, empty states), feedback for every action (toasts, dialogs, spinners), error prevention (validate before save, destructive warnings), progressive disclosure, predictable interaction (click/hover/drag conventions), and user efficiency (shortcuts, inline editing, bulk ops).

file_nodes.name: GlobalTable
file_nodes.summary: Core entity — a metadata-driven data structure defining how data is stored, input, displayed, validated, searched, and ordered. Has status lifecycle (Draft → Published → Archived).

file_nodes.name: Column
file_nodes.summary: Field definition within a Global Table specifying data type, behavior, and UI rendering. Supports 10 types: text, number, date, time, datetime, image, select, richtext, relation, computed.

file_nodes.name: Record
file_nodes.summary: A single data entry in a Global Table, stored as a JSON document with column values as key-value pairs.

file_nodes.name: GlobalTable Lifecycle
file_nodes.summary: State machine for GlobalTable: Draft (freely modifiable) → Published (available for Components, restricted changes) → Archived (no new references, data preserved). Supports unpublish back to Draft.

file_nodes.name: Column Type System
file_nodes.summary: Column type configuration system defining input components, storage formats, and type-specific configs. Includes progressive disclosure for type-specific options.

file_nodes.name: Auto-Generated CRUD
file_nodes.summary: System auto-generates full CRUD operations for each Global Table — browse, create, read, update, delete — without manual coding.

file_nodes.name: Dynamic Form Generation
file_nodes.summary: Forms are dynamically generated from column definitions — field types (text input, date picker, select, etc.) determined by column type, with computed fields displaying calculated values and relation fields showing selectable options.

file_nodes.name: Expression Engine
file_nodes.summary: External dependency for computed columns — evaluates expressions like 'harga * jumlah' to calculate values. Must prevent circular references.

file_nodes.name: Collections API
file_nodes.summary: REST API for Global Table collection management — CRUD operations, status transitions (publish/unpublish/archive), with pagination, search, and filtering.

file_nodes.name: Columns API
file_nodes.summary: REST API for column management within a Global Table — add, update, delete (blocked if data exists), and reorder columns.

file_nodes.name: Records API
file_nodes.summary: REST API for record management — CRUD with search across searchable columns, sorting by orderable columns, and pagination.

file_nodes.name: Validation Rules
file_nodes.summary: 13 validation rules (VR-GT-001 to VR-GT-013) covering table name uniqueness, snake_case format, required fields, column name uniqueness, type-specific validation (select options, computed expressions, relation targets).

file_nodes.name: Permission Rules
file_nodes.summary: 8 permission rules (PR-GT-001 to PR-GT-008) defining role-based access — Administrator has full control, Staff can read published tables only.

file_nodes.name: State Transitions
file_nodes.summary: 4 state transition rules (ST-GT-001 to ST-GT-004) governing GlobalTable lifecycle: Draft↔Published, Published→Archived, with conditions for each transition.

file_nodes.name: Business Constraints
file_nodes.summary: 8 business constraints (BC-GT-001 to BC-GT-008) with severity levels — CRITICAL (uniqueness, min columns), HIGH (data protection, expression validity, relation targets), MEDIUM (required values, select options).

file_nodes.name: Side Effects
file_nodes.summary: 5 side effects (SE-GT-001 to SE-GT-005) — publish makes table available for Components, archive removes from relation selectors, column deletion causes data loss, type change may break data, adding required column needs defaults for existing records.

file_nodes.name: Acceptance Criteria (AC-001 to AC-020)
file_nodes.summary: 20 acceptance criteria organized by feature area — CRUD operations, validation, search/sort/pagination, column management, state transitions, empty/loading states, computed/relation/select columns.

file_nodes.name: User Stories (US-001 to US-006)
file_nodes.summary: 6 user stories — US-001 Create Global Table, US-002 Manage Columns, US-003 Browse Records, US-004 Create/Edit Records, US-005 Delete Records, US-006 Publish Collection.

file_nodes.name: Implementation Tasks (TASK-001 to TASK-014)
file_nodes.summary: 14 implementation tasks covering the full stack: database schema, shared types/schemas, repository, service, API routes (collection/column/record), composable, UI components (list, workspace, column builder, record form), tests, and verification.

file_nodes.name: Test Cases
file_nodes.summary: Comprehensive test suite — unit tests (service, column, record), integration tests (collection lifecycle, record management), API tests (collection and record endpoints), E2E tests (admin flows), and edge case tests.

file_nodes.name: UI Specification
file_nodes.summary: UI specification covering pages (Collections List, Workspace, Create), component hierarchy, tables (Records, Columns), forms, column builder layout, navigation, responsive behavior (desktop/tablet/mobile), and state handling (loading, empty, error).

file_nodes.name: UX Specification
file_nodes.summary: UX specification covering user flows (create, add column, add/edit/delete record, publish), interactions (type selection, column reorder, inline edit, row selection), feedback patterns, empty/loading/error states, confirmation dialogs, and keyboard shortcuts.

file_nodes.name: GlobalTable Invariants
file_nodes.summary: Domain invariants ensuring data integrity — unique names, unique column names within table, minimum columns, protected published data, valid expressions, valid relation targets, matching record data keys, required column values.

file_nodes.name: GlobalTable Relationships
file_nodes.summary: Entity relationships — GlobalTable 1:N Column, GlobalTable 1:N Record, Column N:M Column (via relation table_id), Record referenced by Relation columns in other tables.

file_nodes.name: Non-Functional Requirements
file_nodes.summary: Performance targets — NFR-GT-001: record browse <500ms for 1000 records, NFR-GT-002: form generation <100ms, NFR-GT-003: search across columns <300ms.

file_nodes.name: Edge Cases
file_nodes.summary: Edge cases — 50+ columns (UI usability), 10,000+ records (pagination required), archived relation targets, invalid computed expressions, column type change on existing data.

file_nodes.name: Expression Engine Acceptance Criteria
file_nodes.summary: Defines 6 acceptance criteria (AC-001 through AC-006) for the Expression Engine, covering mathematical evaluation, string concatenation, conditional logic, nested variable resolution, undefined variable handling, and number formatting. Each AC maps to functional requirements and user stories.

file_nodes.name: Expression Engine API Specification
file_nodes.summary: Defines 3 REST API endpoints for the Expression Engine: POST /api/expressions/validate (syntax validation), POST /api/expressions/evaluate (expression evaluation with context), and POST /api/expressions/resolve (dynamic token resolution). Includes request/response schemas and error codes.

file_nodes.name: Expression Engine Business Rules
file_nodes.summary: Specifies validation rules (VR-EX-001 to VR-EX-003), permission rules (PR-EX-001 to PR-EX-002), state transition rules (Raw→Parsed→Evaluated), business constraints (parseability, division-by-zero, undefined variables, depth limit), and side effects for the Expression Engine.

file_nodes.name: Expression Engine Domain Model
file_nodes.summary: Defines core domain entities for the Expression Engine: Expression (mathematical, string, conditional, mixed types), Token (8 token types including Number, String, Variable, Operator, Comparison, Logical, Parenthesis, Function), AST (6 node types: Literal, Variable, BinaryOp, UnaryOp, FunctionCall, Conditional), and ExpressionContext (variable map with parent nesting). Describes the parse→build→evaluate pipeline and invariants.

file_nodes.name: Expression Engine Requirements
file_nodes.summary: Comprehensive requirements document for the Expression Engine covering the problem statement, objective, actors (System, Administrator), 5 user stories (math evaluation, string expressions, conditional expressions, variable resolution, output formatting), 7 functional requirements (REQ-EX-001 to REQ-EX-007), 3 non-functional requirements (performance targets), constraints, edge cases, and dependencies on Template, Component, and Administration modules.

file_nodes.name: Expression Engine Implementation Tasks
file_nodes.summary: Defines 8 implementation tasks (TASK-001 through TASK-008) in dependency order: Tokenizer → Parser → Evaluator → Variable Resolver / Formatter → API Routes → Tests → Verification. Specifies affected source files for each task and verification criteria.

file_nodes.name: Expression Engine Test Cases
file_nodes.summary: Defines comprehensive test coverage for the Expression Engine: 14 unit tests for ExpressionParser (UT-EX-001 to UT-EX-006) and ExpressionEvaluator (UT-EX-007 to UT-EX-014), 3 unit tests for VariableResolver (UT-VR-001 to UT-VR-003), 1 integration test (IT-EX-001), 4 API tests (AT-EX-001 to AT-EX-004), and 4 edge case tests (EC-EX-001 to EC-EX-004).

file_nodes.name: Expression Engine UI Specification
file_nodes.summary: Defines the Expression Engine UI components: Expression Editor (used in Template Builder, Component Builder, Administration Builder), Variable Reference Picker (triggered by @ or {{ with search), Validation Indicator (green check, red X, yellow warning states), and keyboard shortcuts ({{, @, Tab, Escape).

file_nodes.name: Expression Engine UX Specification
file_nodes.summary: Defines user experience flows for the Expression Engine: Write Expression flow (click → type → variable picker → validate → save), Variable Picker flow (trigger on {{ → search → select → insert), Real-time Validation flow (type → validate syntax → resolve variables → determine type → show feedback). Includes feedback types and keyboard shortcuts.
